searchText: Possible in theory, but in practice you usually see low participation because validators are entirely offline, so you cannot get to the unique 2/3 signatures in that case (unless it's maybe right around 64% or 65% and combining multiple partials gives you 67%, but that's rare). Not via libp2p (there is only API to download full blocks), but beaconcha.in and prater.beaconcha.in have this stats if you click on an epoch, e.g. https://prater.beaconcha.in/epoch/86579 has a "sync participation" column That might be indeed true I am getting all the blocks, I don't think there is any better options via REST you can get headers Yaah I am using REST But yeah, what you need is in the body, that's true xD I am using `eth/v2/beacon/blocks/{slot}` Once I have some stats I will post them here might be useful for others as well
